x-m-m2-03.title: Kutsvaga kukanganisa mumhinduro yakatariswa ne x=1

(Nzira yekuverenga: x² ndi 'x squared,' x⁴ ndi 'x kumasimba e4,' uye 6xy² ndi '6 nguva x nguva y squared,' uye tinoparadzanisa ne 6xy² yose mushure me ÷.)
